component.name: CreaBIM
component.summary: Design a building and draw it from one model

description.p: This is a community package of CreaBIM, maintained independently and unaffiliated with its author. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.

CreaBIM is a BIM modeller. One model holds the 3D view, plans, sections, sheets, schedules and quantities, and it reads and writes IFC. It opens on a starter house. It is ready to explore and not yet for production work.
Sandbox: display, GPU, and the Documents folder for projects passed by path. It works offline. Check for updates opens the releases page in the browser and downloads nothing.
